question: Not D. Not E. Somewhere between them lies a place known especially well by those who have just begun their VNR journey.
Your next destination is a place where energy is borrowed, not created. Find the point that gives a device the power to keep going.

I’m not a classroom,
I’m not a library,
Yet somehow students come here to “work.” 💀
I’ve got rocks, trees and benches,
A peaceful spot where time just stretches. 🌳🪨
And nearby stands a place where silicon meets ideas. 💻⚡

Where questions find answers,
and silence speaks the loudest,
begin your search.
Then seek what millions of years have made solid.

Every circle has a point where it begins.
You have travelled far enough to complete yours.
Find the point that has seen you before—
only then is your journey whole. 🔍

I have no roots, yet I never move.
I have no legs, yet I have stood for years.
My surface carries marks left by many hands,
but no one remembers who made them.
Rough on the outside,
silent on the inside.
Look closely…
The past has left its mark here.
What am I?
A tranquil garden where day meets evening light. Find where peace blooms as day turns into dusk.

Where the height of a person suddenly becomes a skill,
Where one mistake can make your whole team yell,
Go where the highest targets decide who has the better thrill.

Your next clue is not inside a block.
It is not where food is served.
It is not where students sleep.
Go to the place where green meets concrete,
where buildings surround an open space.
Search carefully.
The oldest-looking resident there
has four legs.

Leave the usual path behind,
Take the shortcut you’ll find,
Where delicious aromas fill the air, your next clue is there.

Every circle has a point where it begins.
You have travelled far enough to complete yours.
Find the point that has seen you before—
only then is your journey whole. 🔍
“Knowledge is ready. Answers are waiting. But the tools needed to give them a shape are missing. Find the place where ideas become writable.”

I am not a classroom, but many lessons begin with me. I am not a teacher, but I guide those who are lost. I am not a gate, but I welcome people before they enter further. Visitors ask questions, and I help them find the right direction.
Before you enter, a silent guard looks at you. It never touches you. It checks the heat coming from your body. 🌡️
I questioned what others accepted as absolute truth. I made time slow down, showed that space can bend, and connected the smallest particle of matter to enormous energy.
Many vehicles rest beneath my shade, while students come and go throughout the day. I stand quietly near the parking area, giving shelter from the sun.

only then is your journey whole. 🔍
